evals.prompt: Use public CodonFM Encodon to score my variants.csv on one GPU.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses mutation_prediction with MutationDataset, masks the mutation, extracts CDS context, and reports all four merged NumPy outputs.
assertions: The command includes --process_item mutation_pred_mlm and --dataset_name MutationDataset
The agent runs --dryrun before the real evaluation
The agent lists ref_likelihoods_merged.npy, alt_likelihoods_merged.npy, likelihood_ratios_merged.npy, and ids_merged.npy

evals.prompt: Run CodonFM synonymous-codon-aggregated missense_prediction on the public repository.
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that public v1 supports only the general ref/alt LLR and does not silently replace the requested aggregation method.
assertions: The agent does not run missense_prediction or missense_inference
The agent distinguishes general mutation_prediction from synonymous-codon aggregation

evals.expected_output: The agent does not assume CodonFM because no model or tool was named.
assertions: The agent does not invoke a codonfm-* skill without CodonFM or Encodon context
